name: model-agnostic-ai-stack
displayName: Which AI Model Should You Bet On? The Antifragile One.
description: A Built-in-the-Hive playbook: the open-weight versus closed-weight model debate has three possible endings, closed wins, open wins, or a hybrid, and nobody can predict which. This shows professional-services teams how to stop betting on one model and build a governed, model-agnostic stack, gateway, routing, grounding, observability, and security, that adopts whatever wins and runs across cloud, on-prem, and edge. Built on Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Dataverse, and Purview. Generalized from an industry research note; an AI-strategy playbook, not investment advice.
